name: Quarter Burst
description: A multi-color quarter burst radiating from one corner of each cell in bold, flat bands.

code.style: --rule: ( background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); :after { content: ''; @size: 100%; position: absolute; background: @m(4, radial-gradient(circle at @p(-40% -40%, 140% 140%, 140% -40%, -40% 140%), @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 50%, transparent 50%)), radial-gradient(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) @r(10%, 40%), transparent 0); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
